ordersmp-clips.options.title: Clips Options
ordersmp-clips.options.clipping.tooltip: Keeps the last minutes ready to save. Off stops recording until you turn it on.
ordersmp-clips.options.session.tooltip: Recording mode saves everything you play in parts. F6 does the same.
ordersmp-clips.options.kills.tooltip: Save a clip when you kill a player.
ordersmp-clips.options.deaths.tooltip: Save a clip when another player kills you.
ordersmp-clips.options.long.tooltip: Save a fight of 20 seconds or more that ended without a kill.
ordersmp-clips.options.mark.tooltip: The mark in the top left corner: REC while clips are ready, the fight while one is on, LIVE in Recording mode. Minimal shows only the icon. It never shows in your clips.
ordersmp-clips.options.quick.subtitle: Quick setup. Everything else is under Advanced.
ordersmp-clips.options.quality.tooltip: Higher quality uses more memory and disk.
ordersmp-clips.options.fps.tooltip: 60 FPS is smoother, 30 FPS is lighter on your PC.
ordersmp-clips.options.keep.tooltip: How much of the last gameplay is kept ready to save, up to 10 minutes. Longer uses more memory: 10 minutes at 1080p takes about 1 GB. Changing it starts the buffer again.
ordersmp-clips.options.parts.tooltip: Recording mode saves in parts this long.
ordersmp-clips.options.auto.tooltip: What saves a clip by itself. Everything adds long fights without a kill.
ordersmp-clips.options.link.tooltip: Upload clips to your Studio library.
ordersmp-clips.options.send.tooltip: New automatic clips upload to Studio by themselves. Nothing is posted until you post it.
ordersmp-clips.options.send.link_first.t: Link Studio before clips can be sent.
ordersmp-clips.options.advanced.tooltip: Every setting: bitrate, clip seconds, voices, storage limits and more.
ordersmp-clips.options.advanced.title: Clips Options - Advanced
ordersmp-clips.options.delete_all.toolti: Deletes every clip on this PC.
ordersmp-clips.options.delete_all.title: Delete every clip on this PC?
ordersmp-clips.options.delete_all.body: %s clips. They cannot be brought back.
ordersmp-clips.editor.audio.more: %s more voices are kept at their saved volume.
ordersmp-clips.editor.audio.note: The preview has no sound yet. Volumes apply when you save a new clip or upload.
ordersmp-clips.options.volume.game.toolt: Swords, hits and footsteps in new clips. Change any clip in its editor.
ordersmp-clips.options.volume.mic.toolti: Your voice from Simple Voice Chat in new clips.
ordersmp-clips.options.volume.others.too: Everyone you hear in Simple Voice Chat. Change each player in the editor.
ordersmp-clips.screen.empty.import: Have a video already? Use Import or drop an MP4 here.
ordersmp-clips.screen.no_match: No clips match. Try another search or Show: All.
ordersmp-clips.screen.sort.tooltip: What the list is ordered by. The arrow next to it flips the order.
ordersmp-clips.screen.show.tooltip: Which clips the list shows. Search by player, type or date, like Raven or 18 Nov.
ordersmp-clips.screen.keep.tooltip: Kept clips are never deleted by the storage limits in Options.
ordersmp-clips.screen.kept.tooltip: This clip is kept. Press to let the storage limits delete it again.
ordersmp-clips.screen.import.tooltip: Add MP4 videos from your PC to Clips. You can also drop them on this window.
ordersmp-clips.toast.import.some: Imported %s of %s videos. See the log for the rest.
ordersmp-clips.toast.import.none: Only MP4 videos can be imported
ordersmp-clips.options.bitrate.tooltip: Auto picks one for the quality. Higher is sharper but makes bigger files.
ordersmp-clips.options.before.tooltip: Seconds an automatic clip starts before the fight. You can still drag it wider in the editor.
ordersmp-clips.options.after.tooltip: Seconds an automatic clip goes on after the kill or your death.
ordersmp-clips.options.close.tooltip: Kills a few seconds apart can be one clip of the whole fight, or one clip for each kill.
ordersmp-clips.options.my_voice.tooltip: Keep your Simple Voice Chat voice in clips. Off keeps none of it.
ordersmp-clips.options.players_heard.too: Keep the voices you hear in Simple Voice Chat in clips. Off keeps none of them.
ordersmp-clips.options.icon.tooltip: Planned: an icon so others see you record. It needs the server's support, which is not ready yet.
ordersmp-clips.options.size.tooltip: When clips take more space than this, the oldest ones not marked Kept are deleted.
ordersmp-clips.options.days.tooltip: Clips not marked Kept are deleted after this many days. The list shows the days left.
ordersmp-clips.options.status.tooltip: Whether recording works and what it uses.
ordersmp-clips.options.status.title: Clips Status
ordersmp-clips.options.status.no_ffmpeg: ffmpeg was not found, so nothing can be recorded
